description: Generic example deny-list. Each pattern is a JavaScript regular expression source. A write that matches any pattern in any string field (including object keys) is rejected. Replace or extend this list for your own data; the server refuses to start if the list is missing, empty, or invalid.

patterns.description: US-style phone numbers written with separators, e.g. 555-010-0199 or (555) 010-0199
Numbers in the 3-2-4 social security number format
A date-of-birth label followed by a digit
A record-number label (MRN, medical record number) followed by four or more digits
Sixteen-digit card numbers, optionally grouped by four
